_note: Snapshot of the ElevenLabs agent settings, verified against a published agent on 2026-09-19. Apply to your own agent in the dashboard; keep both agents identical. Placeholders in <angle brackets> are per-developer.
_gotchas: Editing fields does NOT save them. The save button is 'Publish' (top right); an orange dot means unsaved changes. 'Test Connection' validates the dialog values without persisting them.
Start from the Blank template. Prebuilt templates ship a persona prompt that encourages rephrasing, and any number the agent invents bypasses the backend numeric guard.

backup_llm must be disabled. On 'default', a failure of our backend silently hands the question to a fallback model with no fact bundle, which will invent figures. Silence is the correct failure mode.
Server URL must end in /v1; the dashboard appends /chat/completions itself.

ngrok free serves an interstitial (ERR_NGROK_6024) to browser user agents. Server-to-server calls from ElevenLabs pass through, but add the ngrok-skip-browser-warning header if you see HTML instead of JSON.
Verify field names against current ElevenLabs docs; the dashboard layout moves.
